# dedalus_machine (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# @custom start
resource "dedalus_machine" "example_machine" {
  autosleep   = "300s"
  memory_mib  = 4096
  storage_gib = 10
  vcpu        = 1
}
# @custom end
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `autosleep` (String) Idle window before autosleep. Accepts fixed duration units like 30s, 30m, 2h, 7d3h4s, or 1w3d, raw seconds ("1800"), or never to disable.
- `memory_mib` (Number) Memory in MiB.
- `storage_gib` (Number) Storage in GiB.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `vcpu` (Number) CPU in vCPUs.

### Read-Only

- `autosleep_seconds` (Number) Seconds of inactivity before autosleep. 0 disables autosleep.
- `desired_state` (String) Available values: "running", "sleeping", "destroyed".
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `machine_id` (String)
- `phase` (String) Available values: "accepted", "placement_pending", "starting", "running", "stopping", "sleeping", "destroying", "destroyed", "failed".
- `status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) The timeout for the operation, default: 600 seconds
- `delete` (String) The timeout for the operation, default: 600 seconds
- `read` (String) The timeout for the operation, default: 120 seconds
- `update` (String) The timeout for the operation, default: 600 seconds

Read-Only:

- `revision` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import dedalus_machine.example '<machine_id>'
```
